remarks: Sound Beach Landing, an exceptional new waterfront community, where luxury meets tranquility in Stamford, Connecticut. Nestled along the beachfront shores of the Long Island Sound, this private enclave showcases breathtaking views of the historic Stamford Lighthouse. Design your new home on one of four half-acre lots, each boasting 100 feet of sandy beach and direct water frontage. The Association also features a private deep water 150-foot pier with additional mooring options. This private Association allows for the serenity of waterfront living with your boat conveniently moored on site. Located conveniently to the village of Old Greenwich with fine dining, shopping and the Metro North train. Rare opportunity to create your perfect waterfront lifestyle.
